name: meridian-browser
description: Meridian MCP bridge (mcp/meridian-mcp.js), the stand-alone stdio server MCP directories list. The browser itself is built from chromium/.

scripts.serve: python3 site/build.py > /dev/null && echo 'Serving the site at http://localhost:8000/' && python3 -m http.server 8000 -d docs
scripts.lab: python3 site/build.py > /dev/null && echo 'Design lab at http://localhost:8010/site/lab/' && python3 -m http.server 8010
